title: Scalar compatibility of augmentation-normalized additive etale Cech edges
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a finite open cover whose intersections indexed by every positive-length tuple are affine, and let n≥0, and let a be any additive equivalence satisfying augmentation normalization [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. Let mu(r) be an endomorphism of the fixed lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction] whose every section component multiplies by the structural pullback of r∈Gamma(X,O_X). Then a(H^n(mu(r))(x))=r•a(x) in the ordinary unit Cech homology [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change]. This asserts only the endomorphism compatibility of supplied normalized equivalences.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine-cover proof; Tag 01EQ, augmentation construction; Tag 01FD, Lemma 20.15.1, commuting augmented double-complex diagram. Worker-written explicit normalization of this argument.

proof.text: Choose the standard injective resolution and a canonical comparison using canonical-data existence. Lift the inverse image of x under the comparison to a global cycle, using epimorphic homology projection.
Choose a common alpha/beta representative z for this cycle and apply normalization to identify its Cech class with a(x).
Transport the common representative under multiplication by r, apply normalization to the transported cycles, and substitute the two class identities to conclude a(H(mu(r))(x))=r times a(x).

proof_origin.place: Common representative and multiplication transport followed by two applications of normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAdditiveCech_normalized_scalar
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (μ : Γ(X, ⊤) → (X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶ X.etaleAdditiveSheaf))
    (hμ : ∀ r (W : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : X.etaleAdditiveSheaf.obj.obj W),
      (μ r).hom.app W x =
        ULift.up ((show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from x.down) *
          (show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from W.unop.hom.appTop r)))
    (n : ℕ)
    (a : Sheaf.H X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
      (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n)
    (ha : IsEtaleAdditiveCechNormalized U n a) :
    ∀ r x, a (Sheaf.H.map (μ r) n x) = r • a x
